name: Renseikan Kyudojo
tagline: Traditional Japanese archery in San Jose, California
description: Renseikan Kyudojo teaches kyudo, traditional Japanese archery, in San Jose, California. Classes Sundays 4:00–6:00 pm. New students are always welcome and the first lesson is free.
policy: New students are always welcome. The first lesson is free with no appointments needed, just walk in during a regularly scheduled class time. No uniform or equipment is required and no prior experience is necessary.
